scope: Local engine/MCP timings, not ChatGPT generation or public tunnel latency. Real NTK extraction plus a synthetic 950-page workload repeating public NTK text. Temporary AES archive with a test-only key wrapping adapter.
method: One before/after run on the same PC/runtime/input. Per-workload median/p95 for repeated local calls; optimized benchmark rerun after tests completed to avoid concurrent test load. No model generation or external tunnel timing.
caveats: Index construction moves to the first SQL/search request; registration alone is not the full first-search cost.
The 950-page workload repeats extracted NTK text; it is not an independently rendered 950-page PDF.
Idle rebuild was forced with a 25ms test timeout; production SQL idle retention is now 5 minutes, renderer retention unchanged.
Rank sorting was evaluated; existing BM25 ordering was retained because this workload did not show a reliable gain.
